text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities and performance during the third quarter of 2018. There were 0 lost time injuries and a 50% increase in the number of medical aid injuries in the third quarter of 2018 relative to 2017. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for third quarter 2018 were $2,416.06 lower than in third quarter 2017. As Long Term Disability costs were about the same, the decrease can be attributable to lower Health Care claims charges and WSIB Administration charges.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (November 1, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
